clue.text: The last character to come on the scene lacking a sort of control

parts.note: Z is the final letter of the alphabet

indicators.note: lacking says the following letter is dropped from the word before it

parts.note: to come on the scene is to appear

explanation.surface: A latecomer arrives without some kind of control, as if letters of the alphabet were characters in a play.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'a' after 'lacking' is not a link word: it names the letter that goes, and only one of the two A's is dropped.
explanation.definitionFit: A zapper is a slang name for a remote control for a television.

clue.text: Non-discrimination not the foremost attribute

indicators.note: not the foremost means the leading letter of the synonym is dropped

parts.note: treating everyone alike without discrimination is equality

explanation.surface: Fair treatment for all is described as not being the most important trait.
explanation.definitionFit: A quality is a characteristic or trait something possesses.

clue.text: To talk down to a person — it is nasty

indicators.note: nasty suggests the letters are messed up and rearranged

explanation.surface: Condescending to someone is called a nasty thing to do.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nasty' rearranges the nine letters of A PERSON and IT; 'is' just links.
explanation.definitionFit: To patronise someone is to treat them condescendingly, speaking down to them.

clue.text: The old man breaks snooze maybe for a meal

indicators.note: breaks means the second piece splits the first open

parts.note: a snooze is one kind of rest
the old man is slang for father, PA

explanation.surface: Dad interrupts his nap to eat.
explanation.definitionFit: A repast is a formal or literary word for a meal.

clue.text: Meetings of groups of students outside university

indicators.note: outside says the classes wrap around the university letter

parts.note: forms are school classes

explanation.surface: Student societies hold gatherings off campus.
explanation.definitionFit: Forums are assemblies or gatherings held for open discussion.

clue.text: Become more girly maybe in short garments, charge around

indicators.note: around says the charge goes round the short garments

parts.note: a charge is a fee
minis are short skirts or dresses

explanation.surface: Someone grows more girlish, perhaps by wearing miniskirts and paying for them.
explanation.definitionFit: To feminise is to take on womanly or girlish qualities.

clue.text: Equipment I had to make very firm

parts.note: a rig is a set of equipment
I had contracts to I'D

explanation.surface: Someone's kit was made sturdy.
explanation.definitionFit: Rigid means stiff and unbending, entirely firm.

clue.text: Plant we liked, wild under top of mountain

indicators.note: under puts the shuffled letters beneath, so after, the mountain's top in a down entry
top of picks the opening letter of mountain
wild suggests the letters run riot and are rearranged

explanation.surface: We were wildly fond of a plant growing below a mountain peak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wild' rearranges WE LIKED into ILKWEED, placed under M from 'top of mountain'.
explanation.definitionFit: Milkweed is a plant with milky sap, food for monarch butterflies.

clue.text: A failure departed being hugged and flattered

indicators.note: being hugged says the departed is wrapped inside the failure

parts.note: a dud is a failure
the late means the departed, the dead

explanation.surface: A loser who has died is embraced and praised.
explanation.definitionFit: Adulated means lavishly praised or admired, beyond mere flattery.

clue.text: Son, inept person making run

parts.note: a muggle, from Harry Potter, is someone without skill

explanation.surface: A useless son decides to go for a jog.
explanation.walkthrough: 'run' is meant in the sense of running contraband.
explanation.definitionFit: To run goods is to smuggle them past customs.

clue.text: Regarding cold places, it's what you expect — see about going inside

indicators.note: going inside says the turned word sits within the expected standard

parts.note: par is the expected standard

indicators.note: about turns the little word for see backwards

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning see or behold

explanation.surface: A remark about chilly regions being just as you would expect.
explanation.walkthrough: 'see' is the old exclamation lo, as in 'lo and behold'; 'about' signals the reversal, and 'going inside' the container.
explanation.definitionFit: Polar describes things relating to the regions around the North and South Poles.

clue.text: Walk away from part of football ground depressed

parts.note: a stand is a section of seating at a football ground
down means low in spirits

explanation.surface: A gloomy fan leaves the stadium terraces.
explanation.definitionFit: To stand down from a post is to resign or withdraw from it.

clue.text: Boy's big book left unfinished

indicators.note: left unfinished means the final letter is cut off

parts.note: a tome is a large heavy book

explanation.surface: A boy has abandoned his hefty book partway through.
explanation.definitionFit: Tom is a boy's name, a short form of Thomas.

clue.text: Restrained ceremony offered by Brazil, say, with love

parts.note: a rite is a ceremony
a Brazil is one kind of nut
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A ritual offered by the country Brazil, with affection.
explanation.walkthrough: Brazil looks like the country but is the nut.
explanation.definitionFit: Ritenuto is a musical direction meaning held back, slowing immediately.

clue.text: Country paper's content sent back, requiring editor's intervention

indicators.note: intervention says the editor gets between the letters of the other piece
sent back means the word is reversed

parts.note: a newspaper contains news
ED is the abbreviation for editor

explanation.surface: A newspaper article is returned and must be checked by the editor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'paper's content' is what a newspaper carries, not a hidden run of letters; 'sent back' reverses it into SWEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Sweden is a Scandinavian nation.

clue.text: Garment was falling short, one to cast out

indicators.note: falling short means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

indicators.note: out signals the letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: An item of clothing was inadequate, so somebody tossed it away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'falling short' cuts WAS to WA; 'out' rearranges TO CAST into STCOAT.
explanation.definitionFit: A waistcoat is a sleeveless garment worn over a shirt, a vest in America.

clue.text: Bit of wire stuck into locks?

definitions.text: Bit of wire stuck into locks?

parts.words: Bit of wire stuck into locks?
parts.note: suggests a burglar picking a lock, but the locks are of hair, held by a small sprung metal clip

explanation.surface: A burglar pokes a piece of wire into door locks.
explanation.walkthrough: Locks are tresses of hair, not door fastenings.
explanation.definitionFit: A hairgrip is a small bent wire clip that holds hair in place.

clue.text: Rested one day of the week

definitions.meaning: past tense of sit, as in having rested in a seat

explanation.definitionFit: Sat means was seated, and Sat abbreviates Saturday.

clue.text: A fighting group having the last word to get the latest in excellent equipment

parts.note: RM is the Royal Marines
amen is the final word of a prayer

indicators.note: the latest in picks the final letter of excellent

explanation.surface: A combat unit gets the final say to acquire top-quality kit.
explanation.definitionFit: Armament means military weapons and equipment.

clue.text: Guide losing character at the back in field

indicators.note: losing character at the back means the final letter goes

parts.note: to lead is to guide

explanation.surface: A guide loses someone at the rear of the group in a meadow.
explanation.definitionFit: Lea is a poetic word for a meadow or grassy open land.

clue.text: Madame in vessel, one causing a blockage

indicators.note: in says the Madame abbreviation sits inside the vessel

parts.note: a jar is a vessel

explanation.surface: A lady stuck inside a jar is blocking the way.
explanation.definitionFit: A jammer jams things, such as a device blocking radio signals.

clue.text: Bird not far off the ground, beginning to end

indicators.note: beginning to end means the first letter moves to the back

parts.note: low means near the ground

explanation.surface: A bird flying low, near the ground, from start to finish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beginning to end' moves L from the front of LOW to the back.
explanation.definitionFit: An owl is a nocturnal bird of prey.

clue.text: Unit with weapons also having to be in scheme

indicators.note: to be in says the also word sits within the scheme word

parts.note: a plan is a scheme
too means also

explanation.surface: An armed squad is also part of the plot.
explanation.definitionFit: A platoon is a small military unit of soldiers.

clue.text: Was responsible for a sound game and came first

parts.note: whist is a card game
led means was in front

explanation.surface: Someone was in charge of a good game and won.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound' looks like an adjective meaning reliable but is a noun, a noise.
explanation.definitionFit: Whistling makes a sharp sound, so the whistler is responsible for it.

clue.text: Spell cast on poor actor in northern town

parts.note: a hex is a spell or curse
a ham is a bad overacting performer

explanation.surface: A bad actor has a curse put on them in a town up north.
explanation.definitionFit: Hexham is a market town in Northumberland, in the north of England.

clue.text: Nymphs out of water and awfully sad

parts.note: dry means without water

indicators.note: awfully suggests the letters are badly jumbled

explanation.surface: Water nymphs stranded on land are dreadfully unhappy.
explanation.definitionFit: Dryads are tree nymphs in Greek mythology.

clue.text: Female relation given piece of furniture, as may be allowed

parts.note: gran is grandmother
a table is furniture

explanation.surface: Grandma is given a table, as permitted.
explanation.definitionFit: Grantable means able to be given or permitted.

clue.text: Carried by man, a choice bit of Mexican food

indicators.note: carried by says the letters are held within the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A man carries a tasty Mexican snack.
explanation.definitionFit: A nacho is a tortilla chip, usually topped with cheese.

clue.text: Chinese measure seen to be spiteful

definitions.meaning: a Chinese and Southeast Asian unit of weight, about 600 grams

explanation.surface: A Chinese unit of weight appears to be mean.
explanation.definitionFit: A catty is an Asian unit of weight; catty also means sly and spiteful.

clue.text: You want this puzzle to be so crazy

definitions.text: You want this puzzle to be so
definitions.meaning: a solver hopes to solve the crossword, breaking it like a code

explanation.surface: A solver hopes the crossword gets solved, and feels mad.
explanation.definitionFit: A cracked puzzle is solved, and cracked is slang for insane.

clue.text: Rover and very small governor form a relationship

parts.note: very made small, abbreviated, is V
an aga is a Turkish governor or commander
a bond is a relationship

explanation.surface: A tiny ruler forms an attachment.
explanation.walkthrough: AGA is an Ottoman title for a military commander or governor.
explanation.definitionFit: A vagabond is a wanderer, someone who roams with no fixed home.

clue.text: Spring up, having to talk bombastically about end of war

indicators.note: about says the bombastic talk goes round the letter

parts.note: to spout is to hold forth pompously

indicators.note: end of picks the final letter of war

explanation.surface: Someone rises to rant pompously about the close of a war.
explanation.definitionFit: To sprout is to shoot up or start growing quickly.
